evidence.observation: “Milestone closure replays two source documents, a duplicate observation, one accepted group, one declined group and an interrupted restart. Compare the final model digest, surviving references, located evidence, decision identities, counters and terminal reason between uninterrupted and resumed runs.”

“The integrated test” performs additive growth and a merge, while “The recovery comparison runs the same leave and merge in separate temporary workspaces.” In tests/test_consolidation_loop.py, test_located_additive_growth_then_consolidation does not interrupt or compare resumed outcomes; test_recovery_matches_uninterrupted_history starts with prepopulated facts and does not run additive preview and apply.

concerns.recommendation: Run one uninterrupted and one interrupted execution of the full two-document, duplicate-observation, leave-and-merge scenario, and record the required field-by-field comparison.
concerns.title: The required combined closure replay is unproven

evidence.observation: “Review one group at a time against source spans” and “A mutation uses one digest-bound proposal for the entire group.” In src/gnd/evolve/consolidation.py, _check_mutation rejects unrelated object removals but does not reject modifications to unrelated surviving objects. A proposal can merge the selected fact group and also rename an unrelated object type while satisfying that guard.

concerns.recommendation: Reject proposal changes outside the selected group and its necessary row or role rewrites; add a regression with a valid unrelated object modification in the same proposal.
concerns.title: A reviewed group can carry an unrelated model change

evidence.observation: The gates list successful focused checks, but the narrative says “The post-repair focused and RF6 checks returned 32 passed in 17.73s before the directory-alias regression was added.” It also says the 1053-test selection ran “on the earlier implementation” and the wheel test “preceded the final review repairs.” No result on the final CG3 bytes is recorded.

concerns.recommendation: Run the affected focused and packaging checks on the final CG3 bytes and record their commands and results before claiming the gates passed.
concerns.title: CG3 results precede the final repair and regression

response.summary: The close evidence does not demonstrate the required combined recovery replay or verification of the final CG3 bytes. The consolidation guard also permits changes outside the reviewed group.
